entry.name: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Generative AI LLMs
entry.note: The entry credential in the NVIDIA program for generative AI and large language models
entry.audience: Developers and practitioners working with large language models

reading.format: A one hour exam with 50 to 60 multiple-choice questions, taken in English. Candidates need a Certiverse account to access it.
reading.summary: The NCA Generative AI LLMs certification is an entry-level credential. It validates foundational concepts for developing, integrating and maintaining AI-driven applications that use generative AI and large language models with NVIDIA solutions. Candidates pass an exam to earn it.
reading.audience: The page describes it as an entry-level credential. It expects a basic understanding of generative AI and large language models.
reading.validity: Valid for two years from issuance. Recertification may be achieved by retaking the exam.
reading.prerequisites: A basic understanding of generative AI and large language models.
